title: Employee Analytics — SQL
description:
Write a SQL query to calculate the average salary by department from the employees table.

The result should have two columns: `department` and `avg_salary`.

The average salary should be rounded to 2 decimal places.
expected_answer: SELECT department, ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) as avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department ORDER BY department;

title: Employee Analytics — Pandas
description:
Write Python code using pandas to calculate the average salary grouped by department.

Create a DataFrame called `result` with columns `department` and `salary` (the average).
